notes.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies Now Available
notes.notes:
[b]We're delighted to announce that Vendir: Plague of Lies is now available on Steam! 
[/b]
[i]The once-great kingdom of Vendir is now under the tyrannic King Elrik who rules with an iron fist, his judgments harsh and his punishments torturous. When discovering an ancient prophecy promising the end of Elrik's reign, two siblings must make their way from one muddy end of the Kingdom to the other- inciting Elrik’s wrath every step of the way. Challenge the truth in a Kingdom drowning in a plague of lies.[/i]

Expect to encounter an intricately crafted world, steeped in history and brought to life through a carefully crafted atmosphere and the stories of the people that inhabit it. It is a world where your decisions will have real weight and consequence - in conversation, combat, crafting and every other aspect of this old-school RPG created by a team with a true passion for the genre.

notes.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies Out May 30th 2024
notes.notes:
Mark your calendars! Vendir: Plague of Lies launches on May 30th, 2024! Get ready to dive into hours of enthralling gameplay set in a newly crafted world brimming with intrigue and tactical combat.

The price will be USD: $14.99 / EUR: €14.99 /GBP: £12.79

Explore a rich narrative and assemble your party however you like, mixing between 10 different classes. Arm your party with over 1500 diverse items and 16 weapon types. Discover various synergies that will demolish your enemies.

[b]Special Discount for Vampire's Fall: Origins Owners[/b]
As a thank you to our loyal fans, anyone who already owns Vampire's Fall: Origins will receive a 10% discount on Vendir: Plague of Lies at launch.

Join the adventure and uncover the secrets of a plague-ridden world!

notes.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies - Developer Plays
notes.notes:
[i]Vendir: Plague of Lies is coming soon to Steam, and is featured in February's Steam Next Fest. Please join Early Morning Studio's Daniel Lagergren for a 1-hour Developer Play session.[/i]

[b]About Vendir: Plague of Lies[/b]
The once-great land of Vendir is now rife with poverty, torment and worse. King Elrik rules with an iron fist, his judgements harsh and his punishments torturous. But when an ancient prophecy, that promises to end Elrik’s reign, is unearthed, two siblings fight to ensure destiny comes to pass.

Vendir: Plague of Lies is a classic party-based RPG with a deep storyline and synergy-heavy combat. Look forward to many hours of gameplay filled with memorable characters, intense battles, deep and engaging quests, character skills, and gear progression in the vein of old-school RPGs of the late 90s and early 2000s.

notes.title: Vendir: Plague of Lies in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are happy to announce that Vendir: Plague of Lies is taking part in this week's Steam Next Fest. 

Try our game demo and tune in for our dev livestream on Tuesday 6th of February at 10 PM CET. 

Don't hesitate to reach out to us with your impressions and suggestions, we look forward to reading them. :D
